rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: DICroyal
Exhibition name: Princess Royal
rows.Origin:
Bred by Colin Dickson (1956-....) (United Kingdom, before 1992).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Dickson Nurseries Ltd. / Dickson Roses in 1992 as 'Princess Royal'.
rows.Bloom: Apricot or apricot blend. Mild fragrance. 26 to 40 petals. Average diameter 3.25". Medium, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Armed with thorns / prickles, bushy. Large, semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: up to 32" (up to 80cm). Width: up to 2' (up to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
